text:
incident-bot: PAGED oncall -> p99 latency breach on dedicated-pool-eu-west. Alert: sustained p99 > 4s for 6m, streaming stalls observed. Incident ID INC-7162468.

mira: I see the alert in HUD. p95 jumped from 220ms to ~1.2s, p99 ~4.2-5.1s. Queue depth for pool eu-west-shot is climbing.

samir: taking this as oncall. any customer visible errors? metrics say streaming stall rate up ~12% on live RPCs.

jon: looks like autoscaler handshake laged last scale event. warmup failures logged: some replicas never transitioned Ready, causing backlog growth.

sasha: confirmed. logs show warmup timeout: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:09Z warmup: kernel probe timeout after 120s (vm: dedicated-gpu-3)
2026-03-15T10:12:12Z handshake: init_stream failed: NO_KV_CACHE
```

elaine: customer impact: three customers saw request timeouts (stream disconnect), one reported degraded chat updates. CS opened a ticket referencing INC-7162468.

nora: tagging config: scale-policy=burst-aware, min=6, desired=18, max=36. autoscaler attempted +6 at 10:11:50 but only 2 nodes got Ready before cutoff.

ops-bot: recent autoscaler events (last 15m): [ERROR] handshakes=3 failed, warmup_time>90s for 40% of new nodes, cooldown triggered.

mira: immediate mitigation suggestions? can we reroute wholegroup traffic to eu-central spare pool? risk to latency but reduces p99.

samir: plan: 1) temporarily increase handshake timeout to 240s for this pool; 2) enable manual add of 4 warmed nodes (hotshot) in eu-west; 3) shift non-SLA traffic to eu-central. I'll coordinate.

jon: manual node add command: 
```
./infractl pool add-nodes --pool eu-west-shot --count 4 --label hotshot
```

jon: also increase warmup concurrency by setting WARMUP_PARALLEL=3 for provisioning job.

sasha: doing the config change now (in deployment tag warmup-v2). Rolling change will not disrupt existing Ready nodes.

ops-bot: change applied: WARMUP_PARALLEL=3 -> deployment/provisioner/eu-west. Handshake timeout patched to 240s for pool eu-west-shot.

mira: reroute step: add routing policy to divert best-effort customers to eu-central via weight 0.25.

nora: routing update applied. non-SLA traffic now at 25% eu-central. Observability: queue depth started decreasing at 10:18. p95 down to ~450ms, p99 trending down from 5.1s to 2.6s.

samir: manual hotshot nodes reported Ready at 10:21:14 and 10:22:47. That gave immediate drainage. Streaming stall rate halved.

elaine: CS update sent: "We're mitigating increased latency by adding capacity and routing non-SLA traffic away. We'll follow up with a RCA."

jon: follow-up tasks (post-incident): 1) root cause warmup flakiness — investigate kernel probe timeouts on certain GPU SKUs; 2) adjust autoscaler grace to account for longer warmup under load; 3) add better metric for warmup success-rate; 4) document manual hotshot play.

mira: bookmarking logs for RCA: link-> https://infradash/redwood/incidents/INC-7162468/logs (private).

ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated. Current p99 1.1s, p95 320ms, queue depth stable. Paging cleared at 10:23.

samir: I'll run the short postmortem. If anyone wants to add notes, drop them here. Great cross-team response. :thumbsup:

sasha: note: some older nodes failed to warm because of kernel driver mismatch after a recent micro-kernel update. Might require a rollback for the image. Adding to RCA.

nora: adding alert tune: fire only if p99 > 3s AND queue_depth > 150 for 3m to reduce noise.

mira: thanks team. leaving summary in incident tracker and tagging owners for follow-ups.

samir: closing paging — moving to follow-up channel #incidents-postmortems.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7162468 status changed -> RESOLVED (mitigated). Pager duty note added.
